summary: V4-05 Balances history/edit/delete/share not implemented. Candidate checkout matches pristine accepted tree exactly. The balances.tsx shows paginated history but history rows are read-only text display — no edit, delete, or share actions. Repositories support update/delete and domain invariants hold, but UI layer is missing.

findings.problem: History rows are read-only — no edit, delete, or share actions. V4-05 requires: edit tâche depuis Balances, edit dépense depuis Balances, delete replay/tombstone correct, share natif depuis Balances.
findings.evidence: Lines 894-917: historyRow renders formatActivityRow as Text with numberOfLines={2}, no onPress, no action buttons. No navigation to edit screen, no delete confirmation, no share invocation.
findings.requiredFix: Make history rows interactive: onPress opens action sheet/modal with Edit, Delete, Share. Edit navigates to edit screen (reuse add.tsx with edit mode or new edit screen) pre-filled with entry data. Delete shows confirmation, calls repos.contributions.delete or repos.expenses.delete, emits dataChange. Share uses services.share.share with formatted message. Preserve paginated loading and delta refresh.
findings.verification: Manual test: open Balances → Activity section → tap a task row → action sheet appears → Edit opens form pre-filled → Save updates entry and balances refresh via delta. Delete confirms → entry removed, balances update, zero-sum holds. Share opens native sheet with formatted text.

findings.problem: Add screen lacks edit mode support. Translation keys 'add.editBanner' and 'add.update' exist but no edit logic.
findings.evidence: No edit mode state, no pre-fill from existing entry, no update submission path. Only create flow implemented.
findings.requiredFix: Add edit mode to add.tsx: accept route params (entryId, entryType) or use router params. When editing, pre-fill form with entry data, show 'add.editBanner' title, use 'add.update' button text, call repos.contributions.update or repos.expenses.update on submit. Preserve all existing create functionality.
findings.verification: Manual test: from Balances history, tap Edit on a task → navigates to Add screen in edit mode → form pre-filled → modify value → Save → returns to Balances → balances updated via delta, zero-sum holds.

findings.problem: Missing i18n keys for history entry actions (edit, delete, share confirmations) in both FR and EN.
findings.evidence: Catalog has 'add.editBanner', 'add.update', 'add.errorEdit', 'add.errorDelete', 'add.deleteTitle', 'add.deleteConfirm' but no keys for history-specific confirmations or share from history.
findings.requiredFix: Add keys: 'balances.editEntry', 'balances.deleteEntry', 'balances.shareEntry', 'balances.deleteConfirmTask', 'balances.deleteConfirmExpense', 'balances.editTask', 'balances.editExpense'. Ensure FR accents and EN parity.
findings.verification: Run i18n:check — all keys present in both locales, no forbidden wording, French accents correct.
